assessment.title: Unit 2 Test: Atomic Structure
assessment.instructions: 32 questions on Unit 2 (Chapter 7), 40 points: atomic models, the parts of the atom, atomic calculations and isotopes, reading the periodic table, and electron arrangement and Bohr models. Have your periodic table out. Questions marked 2 points are worth more; on number questions, type just the number. Show your work on scratch paper.
